critical_code_review_comments: Fix scope is minimal and correct: 2 CSS string lines in pp-feedtabs-v1.js (lines 103-104). No JS/HTML/DOM changes. paintProductenOverview output unchanged.

object-fit:contain + neutral #0f0c08 background is the right call for fashion photography — letterbox bars blend invisibly with the dark theme. display:flex + align/justify center keep the contained image properly positioned.

Note (non-blocking): a 3/4 portrait aspect-ratio still forces a fixed box; if a brand uploads a 16/9 landscape or 1/1 square product image, it will be letterboxed horizontally. This is acceptable given fashion photography is dominantly portrait, and the letterbox is invisible against the dark theme. Optional future enhancement: dynamic aspect-ratio per image, but NOT required and explicitly out-of-scope per user 'geen andere wijzigingen'.

rca of the issue: User report (Dutch): partner-product images on the Uitgelicht page were cropped at head/feet. RCA: the .pp-uitg-prod-img container in pp-feedtabs-v1.js was styled with aspect-ratio:1/1 (square box) and the inner with object-fit:cover (fill box, crop overflow). Fashion photography is dominantly portrait (taller than wide), so a square box with cover forced cropping at top/bottom — exactly the head/feet cut-off the user observed. Mitigation (v60.1.160): switched container to aspect-ratio:3/4 (portrait orientation matching fashion photo proportions) and inner img to object-fit:contain (full image fits inside the box; sides are letterboxed with the neutral #0f0c08 background which blends invisibly with the dark theme). Reproduction is purely visual on the Cloudflare-deployed PWA; this audit verifies the source files + deploy bundle now contain the corrected CSS strings. Zero JS/HTML/DOM/logic changes — single-file, two-CSS-string-line fix.
